steps: Peel and cube sweet potato, then boil in water for 12 minutes until completely tender.
Drain sweet potato and mash with coconut milk until smooth; set aside to cool slightly.
Flake salmon into a large bowl, removing any bones and skin.
Finely slice green onion and chop fresh dill; add both to the bowl.
Add mashed sweet potato, egg, rice flour, lemon juice, and salt to the bowl.
Mix gently until a firm mixture forms; shape into 16 equal round patties.
Heat olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Cook patties in batches for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden and cooked through.
Transfer to a paper-towel-lined plate; serve warm. Refrigerate leftovers up to 2 days.
